title: Lethal Company
provenance: Community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), then a Highball report by phmuni (highball-db#124, 2026-09-18): rated 5, perfect, on DXMT, Apple M5, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, Highball 0.9.23, ten minutes played through Highball. Not run here. Tobino006 (highball-db#667, 2026-10-24), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, msync, rated 4 of 5 after 7 minutes. Fortisradix (highball-db#1293, 2026-11-17), Apple M3, macOS 26.4.1, Highball 0.10.28, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r30, DXVK, rated 5 of 5 after 9 minutes: some lag, which in the player's words depends on how much memory the Mac has.
notes: Boots with no configuration and runs smoothly at 120 fps on an M5 in the one Highball report, stable over a ten-minute session. Longer play and lobbies are not recorded yet. On an M2 with DXMT a player found a small input delay and occasional stutter, rating it 4 of 5 (highball-db#667). An M3 rated it perfect with DXVK on the Wine 10 engine r30 over 9 minutes, with some lag the player ties to the Mac's memory (highball-db#1293).
